about_the_game:
This is a casual puzzle game, with game graphics consisting of:

A warm moment of an old lady in her vibrant little vegetable garden. As the absolute focus of the scene, she is wearing a wide brimmed straw hat, a red short sleeved shirt decorated with pink and white patterns, dark pants, and a pair of pink shoes, with a kind and joyful smile. She was extending her arm and pointing towards the crop on the right side of the screen, as if proudly showcasing her labor or sharing the joy of planting with others. The background of the picture is a low wall made of irregular red bricks, with lush trees visible behind the wall. The branches are covered with green fruits, possibly peaches or plums. On the left side of the vegetable garden, on which vines climb, showcasing the wisdom of rural life.

Game starts:

Click on 'Start Game', the image will be grayed out, and the colored parts will be randomly scrambled into 16 small fragments, scattered randomly on the screen

Game process:

Players click on the small image, drag it to its original position to restore it, until all the small fragments move to the correct position, and the game ends

End or start the next game:

All the small fragments are moved to the correct position, and the game ends. At this point, click "Do it again" to repeat the game
